items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So there I met John Lewis, and we began to play, and rehearse, and have fun playing music... Dizzy said, 'You're hired.' ... Which was John Lewis, Walter Fuller and Dizzy. We had three arrangers.

ctx.x: So during this rehearsal -- well, we had several rehearsals, but during one of the rehearsals, I was just about to leave home, 'cause I lived up near City College, just a couple of doors from there, on Convent Avenue. So I get a telephone call just before I'm about to leave, you know, and it's John Lewis, who'd arrived from Albuquerque, and he said, "Listen, Kenny, I told you I would meet you in New York." I said, "Well, I'll be darned. What are you going to do?" He said, "Well, I'm supposed to go to Columbia,"…
